content:
We have many templates. Need to design a retrosynthesis route up to 5 steps, leaves must be commercially available, total price <=9999. Need to propose route with template IDs and children molecules.

We need to find suitable disconnections. The target is a polyol with a side chain: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O. Looks like a cyclic sugar (maybe a cyclohexane) with an ester side chain (C(O)=O) attached via conjugated diene chain.

Potential disconnections: cleavage of ester to give acid and alcohol? Or cleavage of ether linking side chain.

We can use template that breaks an ether (C-O) bond. Look at template 29646: retro_smarts_template '[C:2]-[OH;D1;+0:1]>>C-C(-C)(-C)-[Si]...' That's a silyl protection removal? Not relevant.

Template 38653: retro_smarts_template '[C:1]/[CH;D2;+0:2]=[CH;D2;+0:3]/[C:4]>>[C:1]-[C@@H;D3;+0:2]1-O-[C@H;D3;+0:3]-1-[C:4]' This is a cyclization forming a cyclic acetal? It converts a diene to a cyclic ether. Reverse would open cyclic ether to diene. Our target has a cyclic ether? Actually O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]... )C... It's a tetrahydropyran? O attached to carbon in ring. Could be formed via acetalization of a diol with a diene? Not sure.

Template 37276: retro_smarts_template '[C:3]-[C@@H;D3;+0:4](-[CH2;D2;+0:5]-[C:6])-[O;H0;D2;+0:2]-[C:1]>>[C:1]-[OH;D1;+0:2].[C:3]/[CH;D2;+0:4]=[CH;D2;+0:5]\\\\[C:6]' This breaks a C-O bond to give an alcohol and a diene fragment. That seems promising: our target has a C-O bond linking side chain (maybe O-CH2-CH=CH-...). So we could disconnect to give a cyclic diol (or alcohol) and a diene acid fragment.

Let's apply template 37276 to target to see precursors.
